main_measure.name: pooled mean of forecast/10 x excess 2-bar return from the 16:00 slot open
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with ordinary t >= 2 (and supporting check passes); reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: signed excess 2-bar return, top third minus bottom third of |forecast| (Welch t >= 1)

decided_by: The main mean is above 0 with t >= 2 and the supporting check passes (Welch t >= 1, top third larger).
reading: Cases are the rows stamped 15:00 UTC with close[t+2] taken two rows later in the same window; cases with forecast 0 are kept; the coin's mean 2-bar return is the mean over the non-overlapping grid (positions 0, 2, 4, ...) of all its windows pooled; thirds are n//3 cases by |forecast| (stable sort); the 300 minimum is checked on the number of cases.
